name: ACI Infocom Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, ACI Infocom Ltd is in the Construction and IT business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ACIIL is engaged in the business of real
estate development, construction, building,
contracting, town planning, infrastructure development, and real estate development. 
Its activities include planning, design, execution, and delivery of high-quality real estate and 
infrastructure assets. The co. has undertaken and continues to undertake projects such 
as residential layout schemes, slum rehabilitation and re-development projects (SRA) in Mumbai, and other allied real estate development initiatives.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.02 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.55% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 428 days.
